character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create an original, highly polished 2D pixel-art character for ShieldQuest, a cozy Singaporean urban life-simulation adventure game.

CHARACTER: Chinese Singaporean female young working adult, approximately 22–28 years old.

ART DIRECTION:
- Cozy modern life-simulator aesthetic with the warmth and charm of a premium indie life-sim game, entirely original.
- Detailed handcrafted pixel art, polished and readable.
- Slightly stylized but natural human proportions.
- Soft shading, clean selective outlines, harmonious colours.
- Friendly, modern, mature-cute appearance.

APPEARANCE:
- Fair to light-medium skin tone.
- Shoulder-length dark brown or black hair, neat and modern.
- Smart-casual blouse in a soft neutral or pastel tone.
- Wide-leg trousers or a neat skirt.
- Comfortable flats or sneakers.
- Tote bag or compact handbag.
- Friendly, approachable expression.

SINGAPOREAN IDENTITY:
- Everyday modern Singapore office / young adult style.
- Urban, practical, warm-weather appropriate fashion.
- Natural and recognisable, not exaggerated or stereotypical.

SPRITE REQUIREMENTS:
- Full-body standing character, transparent background.
- Orthogonal low top-down perspective.
- Consistent proportions across all directions.
- No background, no text, no fantasy elements, no weapons.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET:
A polished, attractive Singaporean life-sim character suitable for a cozy neighbourhood game.
